title: The ProfilePress – Paid Membership, Online Courses (LMS), Ecommerce, User Registration & Login Form, User Profile &…
description: The ProfilePress WordPress plugin up to version 4.18.0 contains a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to extract full email addresses of listed members one character at a time via a boolean LIKE oracle. This occurs through the 'sortby<form_id>' and 'filter<form_id>' parameters. The vulnerability also enables enumeration of users with arbitrary usermeta keys such as ppress_billing_phone. The email address oracle is accessible on default installs that use the plugin's 'Create pages' onboarding feature, as the pp_email_address field is enabled for search by default and the directory page is publicly accessible without authentication or nonce protection.
